The viewpoint looks across the bends from a quiet upper rocky slope, not from within traffic. No readable road signs, flags, shrines or identifiable landmarks invented. Wide three-quarter establishing composition, the whole relevant subject and its immediate surroundings visible.  No readable text, letters, numerals, logos, brand marks, number plates, signs, prayer flags, shrines or watermarks. Leave all figures, dates and narration labels for editing.
